g.title: ED_QSP_Model
g.text: threshold read on a saturating amplifier
is amplified by cGMP gain, converted to smooth-muscle relaxation, and then read out by a
veno-occlusive mechanism that only engages above a critical sinusoidal expansion. PDE5 inhibitors supply
— they multiply the gain on whatever pulse arrives.
Multiplying a pulse that is 40× too small still lands below threshold, which is why the same drug at the same exposure cures one patient and does nothing for the next.

g.title: K_free
g.text: the only quantity the enzyme sees

g.title: L1
g.text: PDE5 inhibitors add no NO; they divide PDE5 activity by (1 + Cu/IC50).
The SAME unbound exposure that takes a vasculogenic patient from
ICP 34 → 62 mmHg takes a non-nerve-spared patient from 5.7 → 5.7.

g.title: L2
g.text: On-demand dosing acts through cGMP (minutes, washes out with the drug).
Once-daily dosing additionally acts through SMI (weeks, survives washout).
Protecting structure cannot restore erection while the NEURAL input is limiting.

g.title: L3
g.text: ③ THE SAME PRODUCT, TWO BEDS.
Cavernosal efficacy and systemic hypotension are the same two-factor
product (NO source × PDE5 inhibition) evaluated in different vessels.
The nitrate contraindication is therefore structural, not idiosyncratic.
